name: Warmaster Laggrond
summary: Warmaster Laggrond is a seasoned orc commander stationed outside the Horde entrance to Alterac Valley in the Alterac Mountains. He oversees recruitment and frontline recognition for warriors answering the call to aid the Frostwolf clan. Through his trials, fighters prove their mettle and earn the respect of the Horde vanguard.

sections.title: Frontline Commander
sections.body: Standing watch in the bitter cold at the threshold of Alterac Valley, Warmaster Laggrond organizes the Horde's war effort against the Stormpike Expedition. He ensures that only capable fighters enter the valley to represent the Frostwolf clan and the wider Horde.

sections.title: The Path of Honor
sections.body: Laggrond tests arriving combatants through the Proving Grounds before directing them into the thick of battle. As warriors spill blood across the frozen peaks, it is Laggrond who measures their standing, bestowing honors upon those who earn renown among the Frostwolves.

faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond is posted near the Horde encampment at the entrance portal to Alterac Valley, high in the snowy passes of the Alterac Mountains north of Hillsbrad Foothills.
He serves as a recruitment officer for the Horde's Alterac Valley war effort, assessing recruits through initial combat trials and rewarding those who achieve standing with the Frostwolf clan.

faq.q: What is the Proving Grounds quest?
faq.answer: Laggrond asks prospective recruits to retrieve a Frostwolf banner from the Wildpaw Den in Alterac Valley. This proves their resourcefulness before joining the campaign.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf clan has long claimed the valley as their home after being exiled during the First War. The Stormpike Guard, an Alliance dwarven expedition, has pushed into the region searching for relics and territory, sparking a bitter territorial war.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Warmaster Laggrond?
faq.answer: No. Warmaster Laggrond is a devoted champion of the Horde and will attack any Alliance trespassers who approach his outpost in the mountains.

angles.text: Warmaster Laggrond serves as your initial point of contact for the Alterac Valley war effort, acknowledging your battlefield achievements on behalf of the Frostwolf clan.
For orcs, answering Laggrond's summons is a matter of heritage, defending the ancestral refuge of the venerable Frostwolf clan from dwarven intrusion.
Laggrond values raw frontline courage and tests prospective champions to ensure they can hold the line against heavy dwarven armor and vanguard charges.
